items.prompt: Which uniform upper bound covers n arrivals, output and k=1 without writing log(1)=0 as zero work?

options.text: O(n log n) time and O(1) total space.
options.why: That space bound omits the k retained values and n returned lines.

options.text: O(n log k) time with literally zero work when k=1.
options.why: Each arrival still performs constant work; the zero-log reading is not a valid uniform bound.

options.text: O(n log(k+1)) time and O(k+n) stored/output space.
options.why: The +1 covers constant work at k=1; the returned lines separately require O(n) space.

options.text: O(n*k) time and O(n*k) heap storage.
options.why: Only at most k values are retained, with logarithmic rather than linear heap movement.

items.explanation: The +1 covers constant work at k=1; the returned lines separately require O(n) space.
